dataset_identity_correction.basis: the three source PDF IDs/hashes and the authoritative dataset manifest

latency_interpretation.eligible_use: quality screening for the 14 complete conditions; rerank latency only as rate-gated end-to-end evidence

harness_findings: The runner marked the campaign completed even when a condition contained query errors.
Rerank usage units in condition summaries were cumulative rather than condition-local.
The networking-specific manifest helper mislabeled this large-books-v1 corpus.
repair_protocol: Rerun the failed condition from the exact private Postgres/Qdrant snapshot at a safer request rate; require 24/24 success and use the restored-state run as the replacement row.
